## Press Release


### Republic Bank and Greenlight Team Up to Support Financial Education at Home


Company Release - 11/5/2026 4:01 PM ET


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


*Partnership gives Republic Bank parents powerful tools to teach money management skills to their children.*


LOUISVILLE, Ky.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Republic Bank (“Republic” or the “Bank”) has announced a new partnership with Greenlight, the award-winning money and safety app for families, giving Republic Bank checking account holders access to the Greenlight SELECT plan at no cost.


Trusted by more than six million parents and kids nationwide, Greenlight helps families teach financial responsibility through real-world money management experiences. The Greenlight SELECT plan allows parents to assign chores, automate allowance payments, send money for everyday expenses, and monitor spending through customizable controls and real-time alerts. Along with a prepaid debit card designed for kids and teens, Greenlight helps young users build healthy financial habits through savings goals and its Level Up financial literacy program, which features educational games and challenges.


Through the partnership, families who register for Greenlight through Republic Bank and link a Republic Bank account as their funding source can access the app at no cost*, representing an annual savings of over $70.


"Financial education starts long before a person's first loan application or investment account,” says Republic Bank President and Chief Executive Officer Logan Pichel. “Our partnership with Greenlight makes it easier for families to teach real-world money skills in a way that's engaging and convenient. We're excited to bring this benefit to our clients and help empower the next generation to make smart financial decisions."


The partnership reflects Republic Bank's dedication to helping clients thrive financially by expanding access to practical financial education tools and resources. Clients can conveniently enroll in Greenlight directly through the Republic Bank mobile banking app, making it easier than ever to combine everyday banking with financial education.


To learn more about Greenlight through Republic Bank, visit[RepublicBank.com/Greenlight](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2FRepublicBank.com%2FGreenlight&esheet=54636467&newsitemid=20261105817066&lan=en-US&anchor=RepublicBank.com%2FGreenlight&index=1&md5=5397097ff80839b768428265d1dfa588) .


** The Greenlight® prepaid card is issued by Community Federal Savings Bank, member FDIC, pursuant to license by Mastercard International. Through its partnership with Greenlight, Republic Bank only provides access to the Greenlight SELECT plan through Republic Bank’s Mobile Banking app at no cost when customers connect their Republic Bank account as the Greenlight funding source throughout the duration of the promotion. Should Republic Bank’s partnership with Greenlight end, Greenlight accounts will remain open unless cancelled by the customer, with pricing and terms to be agreed upon between customer and Greenlight and all monthly fees being owed by customer to Greenlight. Greenlight is a financial technology company, not a bank. The Greenlight app facilitates banking services through Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB), Member FDIC. Upgrades will result in additional fees. See terms at[greenlight.com/promotionsgeneralterms](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fgreenlight.com%2Fpromotionsgeneralterms&esheet=54636467&newsitemid=20261105817066&lan=en-US&anchor=greenlight.com%2Fpromotionsgeneralterms&index=2&md5=127bc3bd43f74898f58f97731ee4bd35) for details.*


**About Republic Bank**


Republic Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) is the parent company of Republic Bank & Trust Company (the “Bank”). The Bank operates 47 banking centers across five metropolitan statistical areas (“MSAs”) in five states. These include 22 banking centers in the Louisville MSA, serving Louisville, Prospect, Shelbyville, and Shepherdsville, Kentucky, and Floyds Knobs, Jeffersonville, and New Albany, Indiana; six banking centers in the Lexington MSA, serving Georgetown and Lexington, Kentucky; eight banking centers in the Cincinnati MSA, serving Kenwood, Norwood, and West Chester, Ohio, and Bellevue, Covington, Crestview Hills, and Florence, Kentucky; seven banking centers in the Tampa MSA, serving Largo, New Port Richey, Seminole, St. Petersburg, Tampa, and Temple Terrace, Florida; and four banking centers in the Nashville MSA, serving Cool Springs, Murfreesboro, Nashville, and Spring Hill, Tennessee. The Bank also offers online banking at[www.republicbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.republicbank.com&esheet=54636467&newsitemid=20261105817066&lan=en-US&anchor=www.republicbank.com&index=3&md5=a8ad787356d2eb9349eb9fe416f14af3) . The Company is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, and, as of September 30, 2026, had approximately $7.08 billion in total assets. The Company’s Class A Common Stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol “RBCAA.”
